title: The Vivaldi Way Olive-Oil Poached Salmon with Herbs & Citrus
originalTitle: The Vivaldi Way Olive-Oil Poached Salmon with Herbs & Citrus
ingredients: 4 center-cut salmon or steelhead fillets (6 oz each), skinless
1.5 to 2 cups extra-virgin olive oil (or half olive oil, half neutral oil)
1 lemon & 1 orange, thinly sliced into wheels
4 sprigs fresh dill, 4 sprigs thyme, 2 bay leaves, and 1 tsp whole black peppercorns
instructions: Season the salmon fillets generously with kosher salt and let sit at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Layer citrus wheels, sliced garlic, dill, thyme, and peppercorns in a snug baking dish or saucepan, nestle the salmon fillets on top, and pour olive oil over until nearly submerged.
Bake in a low 250°F (120°C) oven for 18–22 minutes (or poach gently on the stove at 160°F) until the salmon reaches a silky, custard-like 122–125°F internally.
Lift the salmon from the infused oil with a slotted spatula, spoon a drizzle of the citrus-herb oil over top, and finish with flaky sea salt.
